# Description
In this notebook I will attempt to analyze coding variants and investigate enirchment of genes

# Loading data
```{r}
gwas_grb_clnv <- read.csv(file = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "loci_in_GRBs_clnv.csv"))
clnv <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "clinVar.rds"))
loci_in_GRB <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "loci_in_GRBs.df.rds"))
```

Target genes that match the coding variant phenotype
```{r}
gwas_associated <- data.frame()
grb_associated <- data.frame()
both_associated <- data.frame()

# This data frame does contain any information on clinvar genes
grb_gwas_same_trgt <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:nrow(gwas_grb_clnv)){
# for(i in 10740:10746){
  # print(gwas_grb_clnv[i,])
  trgt_genes <- str_trim(str_split(gwas_grb_clnv[i, "GRB_GENES"], ",", simplify = TRUE)[1,])
  clnv_genes <- str_trim(str_split(gwas_grb_clnv[i, "clnv_gene"], ",", simplify = TRUE)[1,])
  gwas_genes <- str_trim(str_split(gwas_grb_clnv[i, "GWAS_GENES"], ",", simplify = TRUE)[1,])
  
  if(any(is.element(trgt_genes, clnv_genes)) & any(is.element(gwas_genes, clnv_genes)) & any(!is.na(clnv_genes))){
    both_associated <- rbind(both_associated, gwas_grb_clnv[i,])
  }
  else if(any(is.element(trgt_genes, clnv_genes)) & any(!is.na(clnv_genes))){
    grb_associated <- rbind(grb_associated, gwas_grb_clnv[i,])
  }
  else if(any(is.element(gwas_genes, clnv_genes)) & any(!is.na(clnv_genes))){
    gwas_associated <- rbind(gwas_associated, gwas_grb_clnv[i,])
  }
  else if(any(is.element(trgt_genes, gwas_genes))){
    grb_gwas_same_trgt <- rbind(grb_gwas_same_trgt, gwas_grb_clnv[i,])
  }
  
  if(i%%10000 == 0){print(paste0("Loop:[",i,",",nrow(gwas_grb_clnv),"]"))}
    
}
```

write.csv(gwas_associated, file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "coding_variants/clinvar_gwas_associated.csv"))
write.csv(grb_associated, file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "coding_variants/clinvar_grb_associated.csv"))
write.csv(both_associated, file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "coding_variants/clinvar_grb_gwas_associated.csv"))

# Genes associatied with phenotype
Preparing gene sets per phenotype for clinvar and gwas target genes. Subseting for phenotypes that appear in clinvar AND gwas. Matching was done by MONDO ID. This way around 100 phenotypes are included which is not perfect. There are some phenotype (eg. schizophrenia) that semantically would be matched but are not matched with EFO-MONDO or whatever.
```{r}
clnv_phenotype_gene_set <- 
  clnv %>%
  filter(is.element(MONDO_ID, intersect(clnv$MONDO_ID, gwas_grb_clnv$MONDO_ID)))%>%
  filter(!is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene)) %>%
  select(MONDO_ID, CLNDN, gene) %>%
  unique()%>%
  group_by(MONDO_ID, CLNDN) %>%
  summarise(CLNV_gene_sum = str_c(gene, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()

# GRB gene set for phenotypes that intesrect clinvar phenotypes
grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set <-  
  gwas_grb_clnv %>%
  filter(is.element(MONDO_ID, intersect(clnv$MONDO_ID, gwas_grb_clnv$MONDO_ID))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GRB_GENES)) %>%
  select(MONDO_ID, MAPPED_TRAIT, GRB_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(MONDO_ID, MAPPED_TRAIT) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(GRB_sum = str_c(GRB_GENES, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()

gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set <-
  gwas_grb_clnv %>%
  filter(is.element(MONDO_ID, intersect(clnv$MONDO_ID, gwas_grb_clnv$MONDO_ID))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GWAS_GENES)) %>%
  select(MONDO_ID, MAPPED_TRAIT, GWAS_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(MONDO_ID, MAPPED_TRAIT) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(GWAS_sum = str_c(GWAS_GENES, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()
  
```

Calculating proportions (This function is called from the Similarity_of_GWAS_and_GRB_gene_sets.Rmd) for each data set when compared with itself.
```{r}
gene_set_proportions_clnv <- GeneSetProportionMatrix(select(clnv_phenotype_gene_set, CLNDN, CLNV_gene_sum), exclude_set = 0)
gene_set_proportions_grb_sub <- GeneSetProportionMatrix(select(grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set, MAPPED_TRAIT, GRB_sum), exclude_set = 0)
gene_set_proportions_gwas_sub <- GeneSetProportionMatrix(select(gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set, MAPPED_TRAIT, GWAS_sum), exclude_set = 0)
```

# Gene proportions grb-clnv
Calculating proportions of intersecting genes from clinvar vs noncoding gwas and grb associated genes. 
```{r}


if(!all(is.element(grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID, clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID)) || 
   !all(is.element(clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID, grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID))){
  print("!!! Phenotype vectors don't match")
  
  # Additional filtering of clnv phenotype gene sets since 
  # after filtering empty gene grb sets some phenotype dropped out
  clnv_phenotype_gene_set <- clnv_phenotype_gene_set %>%
    filter(is.element(MONDO_ID, grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID)) %>%
    filter(is.element(MONDO_ID, gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID))
  
  grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set <- grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set %>%
    filter(is.element(grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID, clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID))
  
  gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set <- gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set %>%
    filter(is.element(gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID, clnv_phenotype_gene_set$MONDO_ID))
  
   }

  gene_vec1 <- list()
  gene_vec2 <- list()
  gene_vec3 <- list()
  n <- dim(clnv_phenotype_gene_set)[1]
  for(i in 1:n){
    gene_vec1 <- append(gene_vec1, str_split(clnv_phenotype_gene_set[i,3], pattern = ", "))
    gene_vec2 <- append(gene_vec2, str_split(grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set[i,3], pattern = ", "))
    gene_vec3 <- append(gene_vec3, str_split(gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set[i,3], pattern = ", "))
    # len_vec <- append(len_vec, length(gene_vec[[length(gene_vec)]]))
  }
  clnv_grb_matx <- matrix(nrow = n, ncol = n)
  for(i in c(1:n)){
    for(j in c(1:n)){
      clnv_grb_matx[i,j] <- ProportionOfGenesShared(gene_vec1[[i]], gene_vec2[[j]])
    }
  }
  
  clnv_gwas_matx <- matrix(nrow = n, ncol = n)
  for(i in c(1:n)){
    for(j in c(1:n)){
      clnv_gwas_matx[i,j] <- ProportionOfGenesShared(gene_vec1[[i]], gene_vec3[[j]])
    }
  }
  # print(gene_vec)
  # print(len_vec)
  rownames(clnv_grb_matx) <- data.frame(clnv_phenotype_gene_set)[,2]
  colnames(clnv_grb_matx) <- data.frame(grb_clnv_phenotype_gene_set)[,2]
  
  rownames(clnv_gwas_matx) <- data.frame(clnv_phenotype_gene_set)[,2]
  colnames(clnv_gwas_matx) <- data.frame(gwas_clnv_phenotype_gene_set)[,2]

```

# Disease similarity
Setting up mondo ontology
I have no Idea where I downloaded this file but it is:
format-version: 1.2
data-version: releases/2022-08-01
ontology: mondo
```{r}
mondo <- get_OBO(file = file.path(project_dir, inputs_dir, "coding_variant_data/mondo.obo"))
```


There are around 5000 genes from clinvar, comparing phenotype similarities for each and storing in a data frame
```{r}
clnv_genes <- filter(clnv, !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene)) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique() 

# Create an empty data frame with column names
similarity_data_frame <- data.frame(gene = character(0), gwas_sim = numeric(0), grb_sim = numeric(0))

i <- 0
for(i_gene in clnv_genes){

  i <- i +1
  if(i%%500==0){
    print(paste("[Calculating ",i, "out of", length(clnv_genes), "]"))
  }

terms_gwas <- gwas_grb_clnv %>%
  filter(str_detect(GWAS_GENES, i_gene)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

terms_grbs <- gwas_grb_clnv %>%
  filter(str_detect(GRB_GENES, i_gene)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

terms_clnv <- clnv %>% 
  filter(gene == i_gene) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  na.omit()

# any(terms_clnv, terms_grbs, terms_gwas)

sim_grid <- get_sim_grid(ontology = mondo, 
                         term_sets2 = list(terms_gwas, terms_grbs), 
                         term_sets = list(terms_clnv),
                         term_sim_method = "lin")

# similarity_data_frame <- rbind(similarity_data_frame, c(i_gene, sim_grid[1,]))

new_row <- data.frame(gene= i_gene, gwas_sim= sim_grid[1,1], grb_sim = sim_grid[1,2])
similarity_data_frame <- base::rbind(similarity_data_frame, new_row)
}
```
```{r}
# write.csv(similarity_data_frame, file = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, "coding_variants/disease_similarity_with_coding_variants_per_gene.csv"))
```

```{r}
data_ <- similarity_data_frame %>%
  filter(is.element(gene, unique(gwas_grb_clnv$GRB_GENES)))

print(
wilcox.test(x = data_$gwas_sim, y = data_$grb_sim, paired = TRUE, alternative = "less"))
data_ <- pivot_longer(data_, cols =c("gwas_sim", "grb_sim"),  names_to = "sim")

ggplot(data_, aes(x = sim, y = value))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.y.npc = 0.9, label.x.npc = "center", method.args = list(alternative = "greater"))
```

Ok. change orphanet to ORPHA
Moving this into a script since it takes too long to run
```{r}
efo_ids_to_map <- gwas_grb_clnv %>%
  filter(is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MAPPED_TRAIT_ID) %>%
  unique()

tb <- convert_concept(from = "EFO:0004337", 
                      to = "MONDO",
                      # from.concept = "Phenotype",
                      # to.concept = "Disease",
                  step = NULL,
                  intransitive_ambiguity = NULL
                  )

tb <- get_related(from = "EFO:0004584",
                  to = "MONDO",
                  from.concept = "Phenotype",
                  # to.concept = "Phenotype",
                  step = NULL,
                  intransitive_ambiguity = NULL)

dodo_efo_mondo <- list()
ids_err <- c()

for(i in 1:length(efo_ids_to_map)){

# This looks for direct references
dodo_efo_mondo[[efo_ids_to_map[i]]] <- convert_concept(from = efo_ids_to_map[i],
                      to = "MONDO")

# 
if(dim(dodo_efo_mondo[[efo_ids_to_map[i]]])[1] == 0){
   dodo_efo_mondo[[efo_ids_to_map[i]]] <- convert_concept(from = efo_ids_to_map[i], 
                      to = "MONDO",
                      step = NULL,
                      intransitive_ambiguity = NULL)
  
}
if(dim(dodo_efo_mondo[[efo_ids_to_map[i]]])[1] == 0){
  tryCatch({
    dodo_efo_mondo[[efo_ids_to_map[i]]] <- get_related(from = efo_ids_to_map[i], 
                                                       to = "MONDO",
                                                       from.concept = "Phenotype",
                                                       to.concept = "Phenotype",
                                                       step = NULL,
                                                       intransitive_ambiguity = NULL)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Handle the error here (you can print a message, skip, or take other action)
    message(paste("Error for", efo_ids_to_map[i], ":", conditionMessage(e)))
    ids_err <- c(ids_err, efo_ids_to_map[i])
  })
  
  }

}


```
